verdict.rationale: Postman supports contract-style validation through test scripts that assert on live responses (docs-17), governance checks that validate API specs against rules (docs-22, docs-32), and Application Inventory/Playwright integrations that validate API calls against Postman Collections during test execution to catch drift (docs-11, docs-26). However, there is no explicit first-party feature for automated schema/contract diffing against live responses (e.g., OpenAPI schema validation built into test runs), and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this drift-detection workflow works well in practice. Missing for 10: dedicated contract/schema validation feature explicitly tied to live response verification, and independent corroboration of drift detection working as advertised.
